newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila third-liners lead gainers in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Manila third-liners lead gainers in late trade.

text.p: Third-line stocks were the biggest gainers by the late session on Tuesday in an otherwise listless equities market, brokers said.
"When market fundamentals are bad, you play with stocks with no fundamentals," Noel Reyes, vice president of Anscor Hagedorn Securities, said.

He said first half corporate results, although mostly at par with market expectations, were no longer indicative of the full-year performance, especially after the peso depreciated sharply early this month.
Among the leaders were newly converted holding firms Acoje Holdings, which went up 11.43 percent to 10 centavos, and Sefront Resources B, which gained 8.16 percent to 0.70 centavos.
Movie outfit Premiere Entertainment was the most heavily traded stock, gaining 10 centavos to 3.70 pesos.
